### Comprehensive, reproducible example (shows how to generalize synonyms)

**How to reproduce this with code (simple synonym replacement):**

```python
We also want to reduce hazards and improve reporting."""

    "prevent": "avert",
    "protect": "safeguard",
    "reduce": "minimize",
    "improve": "enhance",
}

for src, tgt in synonyms.items():
    text = text.replace(src, tgt)

```
